newsitem.title: USA: US corporate debt issues thin on Tues, hopper full.
newsitem.headline: US corporate debt issues thin on Tues, hopper full.

text.p: New U.S. corporate debt issuance will maintain a relatively slow pace on Tuesday with few exceptions, but the day belies a heady calendar for the remainder of the week, syndicate officials said.
Topping the slate on Tuesday is a $250 million five-year debt deal from Long Island Savings Bank via a Salomon Brothers syndicate, dealers said. The Baa3/BBB rated issue is noncallable.
Away from that, dealers said some privately placed trust preferred issues could emerge but the bulk of both high-grade and junk bond supply is still earmarked for later this week.
